Before sunrise, Thanksgiving is already underway at Roswell Family Farm. 🦃

Feeders filled. Water line raised. Pen cleaned. Fresh bedding added.

As the turkeys grow, their nipple water line has to grow with them. Raising it keeps the nipples at a comfortable drinking height while providing the flock with clean water without open containers getting filled with bedding.

These ordinary morning chores are where your Thanksgiving dinner really begins—months before the turkey ever reaches the table.

We currently have just 24 pasture-raised Thanksgiving turkeys available to reserve.

🦃 $5.00 per pound based on actual processed weight
🦃 Processing included
🦃 Expected processed weight of 20 pounds or more
🦃 Exact weights vary and aren’t guaranteed
🦃 Processing scheduled for November 23, 2026
🦃 Pickup expected November 24 or 25

Online reservations require an $11 nonrefundable reservation payment. Of that payment, $10 is credited toward your final turkey balance and $1 is the online reservation and administrative fee.

Reserve your turkey here:

https://roswellfamilyfarm.com/turkey-orders.html

Follow Roswell Family Farm to watch the flock grow from these early-morning barn chores all the way to Thanksgiving. 🛸
